blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The 12-Fiber MPO (Female) to MPO (Female) Patch Cord is engineered for high-density, multi-fiber optical connectivity in modern data centers and enterprise networks. Built to support 40G, 100G, 200G, and 400G high-bandwidth transmission, this MPO patch cable ensures reliable, low-loss performance for large-scale fiber infrastructures.

Featuring MPO female connectors on both ends, it integrates seamlessly into structured cabling systems, MTP/MPO cassettes, fiber distribution frames, and high-performance switches. Available in both Single-Mode (SM) and Multimode OM3/OM4/OM5 variants, it meets global industry standards including IEC, TIA/EIA, and Telcordia specifications.

This 12F MPO patch cord is ideal for data center interconnect (DCI), cloud environments, hyperscale deployments, and fiber backbone networks, ensuring maximum density with minimal installation time.


Key Features

  • Brand: D CORE
  • Type: MPO Female to MPO Female
  • Fiber Type: OM3 (Multi-Mode)
  • Fiber Count: 12 Fibers (12F)
  • Length: 20 Meters
  • Speed Support: 40G / 100G / 400G Ethernet
  • Jacket: LSZH / OFNR / OFNP
  • Connector: MPO (12 Core)
  • Durability: High-quality fiber construction for minimal signal loss
